Definition
[Conjugate radius] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0303 ↗ appb-def-conjugate-point 1. Definition B.4\group local-comparison-geometry

The conjugate radius of a point $p\in \mathcal M^n$ is \[ r_c(p)\coloneqq \sup \{ r:(\exp _p)_*\text{ is nonsingular on }B(\vec0,r)\} . \]
